Show only the parts this creature uses, and no description text. A plain neutral 1.8 m human silhouette labelled "1.8 m" stands on the sheet for scale, with everything at true scale to it. Place it beside the side view, at TRUE scale to the stated size. Title at the top: "The Tempest Serpent".
